project_title: TRUSTED-V Bosch SDS-Inspired Public Website Redesign

theme_strategy.mode_justification: Bosch SDS inspired editorial design requires a light, spacious, image-led canvas with generous whitespace, strong dark typography, and crisp technical borders.

hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-tv-ink leading-[1.1]

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: The Swiss Grid / Tetris Bento Grid - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12
spacing_and_layout.alignment_rules: Left-aligned for narrative and technical clarity; explicit asymmetrical grid structures for feature story blocks.

header_nav.mobile_drawer: Responsive drawer with accordion groups and persistent Contact sales CTA

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the Bosch SDS inspired light, spacious, editorial visual hierarchy with strong IBM Plex typography and generous whitespace.
Maintain all route definitions in /app/frontend/src/App.js (using .js files, not .tsx).
Ensure every page has a visible, stickied Header navigation and detailed structured Footer.
Ensure high visual contrast on all interactive states (hover, focus, active). Explicitly define text colors on hover (e.g., hover:bg-tv-navy hover:text-white).
All key interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and form submissions MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
Do NOT use automatic carousel rotation. Controls must respond to user click, keyboard, and touch.
Use real images provided in the image_urls block; NEVER use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com or placehold.it.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid standard Vercel dark mode templates or generic centered text. Deliver structured, authoritative, editorial semiconductor layouts with clear asymmetry and technical proof bands.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Full support for prefers-reduced-motion, keyboard focus rings (outline-2 outline-tv-cyan), WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 minimum for body, 3:1 for large display text).
